nameEn: Manufacture of non-wovens and articles made from non-wovens, except apparel
description: This class includes the manufacture of non-woven fabrics and articles made from non-wovens, except apparel.
includes: manufacture of non-woven fabrics and articles by bonding, fusing, needling or other methods
manufacture of disposable items of non-woven fabrics: wipes, surgical drapes, filters
manufacture of non-woven apparel-like products: shoe covers, disposable protective suits
excludes: manufacture of sanitary towels and tampons from non-wovens, see 1709
